signIn.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
signIn.codesLockedHint: Too many wrong codes locked your authenticator app; enter a recovery code.
signIn.linkSent: If an account exists for {email}, a sign-in link is on its way.
signIn.noMethod: There's no way to sign in with {email} on this install. Ask an administrator.
signIn.recoveryHint: Enter one of your recovery codes; each works once.
signIn.ssoError.acceptInvite: You already have an account; sign in another way to accept the invitation.
signIn.ssoError.answerUnverified: The identity provider's answer couldn't be verified; start again.
signIn.ssoError.domain: This organization's single sign-on doesn't sign in addresses at your domain.
signIn.ssoError.emailUnverified: The identity provider didn't confirm that your email address is verified.
signIn.ssoError.expired: The sign-in expired or began in another browser; start again.
signIn.ssoError.failed: Single sign-on didn't work; try again.
signIn.ssoError.incomplete: The identity provider's answer was incomplete; start again.
signIn.ssoError.invalidEmail: The identity provider sent an email address that isn't valid.
signIn.ssoError.invalidLink: This sign-in link isn't valid; start again from the sign-in page.
signIn.ssoError.linkRequired: Your account isn't linked to this single sign-on; sign in another way and link it under Account › Security.
signIn.ssoError.linkedElsewhere: This identity is already linked to another Kaeso account.
signIn.ssoError.noAccess: You have no access to this organization yet; ask an admin to invite you.
signIn.ssoError.noAuthTime: The identity provider can't confirm a recent sign-in; use your password or an email link.
signIn.ssoError.noAuthTimeNamed: {provider} can't confirm a recent sign-in; use your password or an email link.
signIn.ssoError.noSso: No organization uses single sign-on for this sign-in; sign in another way.
signIn.ssoError.noVerifiedDomain: This organization hasn't verified an email domain for single sign-on yet; ask an admin.
signIn.ssoError.orgScheduled: This organization is scheduled for deletion.
signIn.ssoError.otherAccount: You signed in at the identity provider as someone else; sign in there as yourself.
signIn.ssoError.providerIncompatible: The single sign-on connection doesn't work with this identity provider; tell an admin.
signIn.ssoError.providerRefused: The identity provider refused the sign-in.
signIn.ssoError.providerUnreachable: The identity provider couldn't be reached; try again shortly.
signIn.ssoError.signedInAsOther: This browser is signed in to another account, which stays signed in; sign out first to switch.
signIn.ssoError.staleSignIn: The identity provider didn't ask you to sign in again; try again or confirm another way.
signIn.ssoError.throttled: Too many sign-in attempts; try again in a few minutes.
